hypothesis: A fixed 0.2 reduction from the current node network value improves the 16-simulation policy-improvement signal and reduces unproductive exploration at losing roots.
intervention: Zero FPU versus network-value FPU with reduction 0.2. Ownership coefficient stays 1.5. Model, seed, rule profile and all other configured training budgets are unchanged.
qualification: Frozen 3x3 CPU trainer and native FPU-allocation regression passed at b4a7107b; implementation files are identical to that qualification.
primary_metric: Paired-color wins/draws/losses and incomplete games versus pinned official KataGo at 1 and 16 visits, openings [] and [C3,G7], move cap 324, per-game timeout 360 seconds, candidate 16 simulations and cpuct 1.5.
secondary_metrics: training wall time and CPU time
interpretation: Exploratory one-seed follow-up chosen after seeing the ownership pilot. Reuses its already measured control and charges its full compute. Not a fresh confirmatory comparison. Warmup onset may change with game lengths; actual update counts are reported. No superiority claim from a zero-win floor or incomplete pairs.
